mapper.insert: insert into TASK_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_HOST (HOST_IP, ACTIVE_TIME, ACTIVE_STATUS, SYS_EOD_DATE, CPS_GROUP) values (#{hostIp}, #{activeTime}, #{activeStatus},#{sysEodDate} ,#{cpsGroup})
mapper.select: SELECT HOST_IP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_HOST WHERE CPS_GROUP = #{cpsGroup} AND ( ACTIVE_TIME < #{activeTime} OR ACTIVE_STATUS = 'OFF' ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT EXE_HOST_IP AS HOST_IP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_CONFIG WHERE CPS_GROUP = #{cpsGroup} AND EXE_HOST_IP NOT IN ( SELECT HOST_IP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_HOST )

SELECT HOST_IP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_HOST WHERE CPS_GROUP = #{cpsGroup} AND ACTIVE_TIME > #{activeTime} AND ACTIVE_STATUS = 'ON' AND HOST_IP != #{exeingHostIp} AND HOST_IP NOT IN (select distinct LOG.EXE_CUR_HOST_IP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_EXE_LOG LOG WHERE LOG.TASK_ID = #{exeingTaskId} AND LOG.EXE_STATUS IN ('R','P'))
SELECT DISTINCT CPS_GROUP FROM TASK_DISPATCH_ACTIVE_HOST WHERE ACTIVE_TIME > #{activeTimeThreshold}
